why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with the trace and the timers to find why everything turns English after a temporary buff

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

New (to find the English-in-a-fight problem and the heavy feeling)
- The report has a trace now: the last 40 events, kept over a /reload. A fight starts or ends, a new buff on the player (its name when the game lets us read it), a change of the game's addon restrictions, a module that errors, changes state or comes back. Each line has the time (t=) and a c when it happened in a fight.
- The report has timers: the time each module hook and each game event took (perf lines) and the memory of the addon.

Changed
- A module that the circuit breaker switched off in a fight (3 errors in a minute) comes back when the fight ends, 3 times at most. Before, it stayed off until a reload and every buff and text of it stayed English.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- Small page of the icon, solid and above the settings. Shift no longer empties the icon tooltip. Keys go on to the game while our settings are open. Every English line of a buff goes in the report as kind aura.
- Update and New tags, the buffs switch on the Game windows page with a preview, the experimental combat option, the report icon, the game windows switch OFF by default.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
